label_overrides.description: List of IPv6 prefix/label overrides (beyond RFC defaults). Each entry defines a prefix and its label.

label.description: Label value (integer 0–100); lower numbers preferred for source address selection

precedence_overrides.description: List of IPv6 prefix/precedence overrides (beyond RFC defaults). Each entry defines a prefix and its precedence.

precedence.description: Precedence value (integer 0–100); higher numbers preferred for destination address selection
